text: よいが　さめるまで　まつしかないわ

structure.jp: よいが　さめるまで

structure.en: there's nothing to do but wait

patterns.name: 〜しかない
patterns.explanation: しかない after a verb says that is the only choice left. まつしかない = 'can only wait'.

patterns.name: 〜まで
patterns.explanation: まで after a verb means 'until that happens'. さめるまで = 'until it wears off'.
